newsitem.title: USA: Conrail to ask dismissal of suit Monday.
newsitem.headline: Conrail to ask dismissal of suit Monday.

text.p: Conrail Inc expects to ask Monday that a federal court dismiss a suit by Norfolk Southern Corp seeking to block an intended merger between Conrail and CSX Corp, a Conrail spokeswoman said.
"Conrail (and CSX are) expected to file motions to dismiss the complaint on the 28th, (of October)" the spokeswoman said.

In addition, under a schedule agreed by parties in the case, Norfolk Southern is to respond to the dismissal motion by Oct 31, and evidence discovery requested by Norfolk Southern must be completed by November 5, she said.

Norfolk Southern is seeking to block a November 14 Conrail shareholders meeting to vote on waiving Pennsylvania anti-takeover provisions to facilitate the merger with CSX. Norfolk Southern also is seeking to block an initial tender offer for 19.9 percent of Conrail shares, due to expire on November 15.
Norfolk Southern aims to top Conrail'sproposed cash-and-stock merger with CSX, valued at $92.50 per Conrail share, with a $100-per-share cash bid for Conrail.

Conrail has said it would review the Norfolk Southern offer, but that it had previously decided a merger with CSX rather than Norfolk Southern was in the best interests of the company "and its constituencies."
On Thursday, Conrail said the Norfolk Southern case against it in U.S. District Court for Eastern Pennsylvania was "entirely without merit."
A court hearing on the case has been scheduled for November 12 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time.
A Norfolk Southern spokesman had no immediate comment on Conrail's plans to seek dismissal of the suit.
